category: Tiled depthwise-separable conv block (HVX depthwise + HMX pointwise, composition)
edge_cases: depthwise-separable: 3x3 VALID per-channel depthwise (HVX, does NOT lower to matmul) then 1x1 pointwise (dense matmul, HMX)

NHWC layout: C_in=64 channels innermost -> depthwise vectorized across channels (64 int16 lanes = one HVX vector); input bytes widened IN ORDER via Q6_Wh_vunpack_Vb (vzxt deinterleaves even/odd -> WRONG, gotcha)
pointwise matmul M=P=256 (8 M-tiles), K=C_in=64 (2 K-tiles), N=C_out=64 (2 N-tiles)
depthwise is IDENTICAL in baseline and expert (shared cost) -> the measured speedup isolates HMX (pointwise) + DMA/VTCM vs HVX vrmpy pointwise

HMX + uDMA compose in a partitioned VTCM: pointwise weight croutons resident @0x0000 (NTN*NKT*1KB), two double-buffered dw-activation buffers @0x2000/0x4000 (NKT*2KB each), requant-config @0x6000, output crouton @0x7000 -- disjoint
pointwise weights reused across all M-tiles -> packed + chained-uDMA'd once (resident); dw activation crouton double-buffered across M-tiles (chained uDMA of ti+1 overlaps HMX compute of ti)
input ranges keep dw in 0..27 and |acc|<=1728 so |r|<2048 (HMX 12-bit field exact, no saturation)
fused HVX/scalar epilogue: per-output-channel int32 bias -> ReLU -> saturating narrow to uint8; crouton unpack via cacheable buffer + bulk 128B vector copies
bias includes extreme (-2000/+2000) and zero edge values so ReLU-zero, uint8-saturate-high, and passthrough all occur
harness installs identity VTCM add_translation AND enables the HMX context so DMA and HMX coexist
harness reference: scalar depthwise (cheap) then HVX vrmpy pointwise, cross-checked against a scalar golden on output position p=0
bias-omitted near-miss (still HVX+HMX+DMA+VTCM) must fail; note ReLU-omit alone would NOT discriminate since saturate_u8 already clamps negatives
name: i8_depthwise_separable_tiled
signal: compute+bandwidth (depthwise HVX + pointwise matrix engine + on-chip streaming)
